_doc: MANAGERS-1: the one register of managers a system runs. Every system made from the seed carries this file; the tick's reconcile step (worker/src/managers.js) hires every manager that is on and has no runtime row, the dispatch step skips a manager that is off, and the bootstrap hires from the same list. A deployment with different needs changes `switch` only: {"<manager id>": {"state": "off", "reason": "..."}}. A core manager cannot be switched off; an off switch needs a reason; with no switch every manager is on, which is the safe default (an idle manager costs one small read per tick; a missing manager leaves its items undispatched). tick_every and count equal seed/ultrastable.json roles (checked by `python3 -m foundation managers --check` on the platform). Ultrastable is the foundation for any autonomous system. ROLE-ALIGN-1: each manager also names the human software-organization title it stands in for (`human_role`), the decisions it makes on its own (`decides`) and the managers it hands work to (`hands_to`); the platform checks they equal its own register, and each role file's generated block shows them.

managers.for: allocation across every project; the tick heartbeat. Every system has one.
decides: capacity per project
start, pause or stop a project or spinoff
rebalance when fix-only cycles crowd out improvements
keep growth work ahead of fixes when the growth share falls

managers.for: delivery of one outcome: triage, done checks, closing items.
decides: priority and owner label of each new issue
which ready item is dispatched next
release of a stale claim
disposition of an item past its limit (fixed, gate or shelved)

managers.for: the backlog a bare idea does not come with: growth, measures, scouting, improvement items.
decides: which growth and improvement items are filed
rank of proposed pluses against the roadmap
acceptance criteria and prediction of each accepted item
keep or replace a change once its metric is settled
how to build the claimed item
whether a change is substantive enough to open a pull request
which plus to propose after a merge

managers.for: independent verification of every claimed result.
decides: pass or fail of a claimed result, with evidence
whether a green pull request merges
one plus per review

managers.for: the tick, workflows, budgets, deploys and settings.
decides: restart of a stopped clock
open or close an incident from a detector reading
merge of a green pull request and refresh of a stale branch
propose a trust rung change by pull request

managers.for: funding registry and applications. Switch off for a system whose owner pays its running cost and seeks no funding.
decides: promote or drop a funding registry row after reading its primary source
which programmes come first by deadline and fit

managers.for: introducing the work to organizations. Switch off for a private or personal system with no public audience.
decides: which programme or prospect organization is queued, inside the caps
follow up or stop after the last follow-up
suppress a target on opt-out or bounce

managers.for: the outreach calendar and the social queue. Switch off together with the outreach manager.
decides: which queued post is published, inside the gate's caps
which agent owns a target, so nobody is contacted twice
move a target forward when its deadline nears

managers.for: research and white papers. Switch off for a system that publishes no findings.
decides: which finding gets an item or an experiment
settle or reopen an experiment from its measurement
which paper is regenerated and published

managers.for: story, site copy, search and social presence. Switch off for a system with no public front end to promote.
decides: which channels fit, computed from the fact bank
re-weight a channel from its recorded outcomes
which paper becomes the next post

managers.for: licence, notices and third-party licence compliance. Switch off only for a system that ships no code or content to others.
managers.human_role: legal counsel / licence compliance (drafts, never legal advice)
decides: block a public file that lacks its licence, notice or header
flag a dependency whose licence is outside the policy
refuse admin material brought back into the template

managers.for: onboarding and support intake. Switch off for a system with one user who is its owner.
decides: whether a deployed seed is admitted as running itself
file the documentation gap behind an unanswered question
hand feedback that changes ranking to the product manager

managers.for: which managers this system runs: keeps this register true and hires what is switched on.
decides: which roles a system should run, by phase
hire a switched-on manager that has no runtime row
propose a role for a repeated unowned task, by pull request

managers.for: sequencing across projects under the portfolio constraint; deploy-raising and cost-cutting work first when k is under its floor.
decides: order of items across projects
deploy-raising and cost-cutting work first while k is under its floor
the next program item with owner, trigger and probe

managers.for: hosting resources, bindings, cost budgets and deploys.
decides: file each undeclared or drifted Cloudflare resource
narrow the queue to cost-cutting work on a budget breach
pass or fail of the weekly backup restore drill

managers.for: the design language and its experiments. Switch off for a system with no user interface.
decides: the personality of a new system, selected from the library
the verdict of a design experiment at its planned sample
which blue-sky idea becomes an experiment

managers.for: the audited front end and its user paths. Switch off for a system with no user interface.
decides: file one item per audit finding or fallen user path
keep or drop an A/B arm at its pre-registered sample
re-baseline the visual fingerprint after an intended redesign
